scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Cultural Activities In Performing Arts For Building Grants Including Studio Theatres
other_conditions: The applicant must be a not‑for‑profit organization (society, trust or not‑for‑profit company) that has been registered for at least three years.
The organization must have a predominantly cultural profile, promoting performing arts such as dance, drama, theatre, music, fine arts, Indology or literature.
The organization must be well‑established and recognized at a local, regional or national level, with a charter devoted to the preservation and promotion of Indian arts and culture.
Government‑sponsored bodies, university departments/centres or colleges dedicated to the performing arts are eligible provided they have a satisfactory record for the preceding three years.

An organization that has received salary grants under the Ministry’s “Financial Assistance to Professional Groups and Individuals Engaged for Specified Performing Arts Projects” scheme is deemed to meet the eligibility conditions.

The applicant must not have received a building‑grant under the earlier scheme or under this scheme for the same project, unless the new grant is for a studio/experimental theatre and the earlier project is not in default.
The organization must be able to provide a matching share of at least 50 % of the approved project cost.

The organization must organise at least two activities (functions, lectures, seminars, workshops, exhibitions, etc.) in nearby schools or educational institutions and provide a certificate from the principal/head of the institution.
benefits_summary: Grants of up to ₹50 lakh for new construction or purchase of built‑up space in metro cities (₹25 lakh elsewhere), covering up to 60 % of the approved project cost (90 % in North‑Eastern states).
documents_required: Recommendation letter from a National Academy, a government‑run cultural organization, or the concerned State/UT administration
Project proposal documents outlining the proposed cultural space
Financial documents showing the organization’s capacity to meet its matching share (including certified accounts)
Any other mandatory enclosures specified by the scheme
